svg.title: Baseball Hour. Actual terminal cell capture.
svg.text: Select a game and its ballpark
Choose a nearby city or coordinates
MLB, MiLB level, or all leagues
Close, clear search, return to All
Times use the displayed timezone. Dates are MLB slate dates.
+1d means the game starts on the next local day.
Nearby: straight-line miles. Use l for minor leagues, too.
